name: Scanline
notes: Inspiration: a HUD confirming what it sees, not connecting things — translated, not copied: a thin band periodically sweeps the frame, and whichever object it crosses gets targeting-bracket corners instead of a connecting line. Bridge/Chain/Fan are disabled by design in this preset: Scanline replaces 'cause draws a line to effect' with 'the sweep confirms this object matters right now,' one at a time. Use Compare/Timeline/Ripple/Loop as usual. Dark blue-gray ground, cyan accent.
